question: Which metrics should be used to measure answer accuracy in the QA benchmark for evaluating temporal-semantic retrieval?
description: While Exact Match and F1 are standard for QA, we need to confirm if other metrics (e.g., precision@k, MRR) are more appropriate for retrieval-augmented QA.
confidence_basis: Standard practice in open-domain QA evaluation as seen in datasets like SQuAD, Natural Questions, etc.
rationale: In retrieval-augmented QA, retrieval metrics (e.g., recall@k) and end-to-end QA metrics both matter. We should decide which to prioritize.
resolution: Standard QA metrics Exact Match and F1 are appropriate for measuring answer accuracy in the benchmark, supplemented by retrieval metrics like Recall@k and MRR to evaluate the retrieval component.
